headline: Snap introduces Specs Intelligence, a standalone AI assistant
summary: Two outlets report Snap introducing an AI assistant called Specs Intelligence, which works with its AR glasses and will also run as its own app. One names iOS and Mac specifically; the other describes mobile and desktop apps.
